headline: Singapore’s government security plan lists tiered controls for generative-AI systems
summary: Singapore’s official Government ICT&SS GenAI control catalog is marked updated 19 October 2026. Its linked generic system security plan lists eight GenAI controls and one data-classification disclosure control; that SSP page is separately marked last updated 19 October 2026. The profile assigns four GenAI controls to Level 0, which the policy defines as cardinal and mandatory, and four to Level 1, which agencies apply according to system risk; agencies may customize the template. The controls cover data-classification limits for overseas-hosted and Singapore-hosted APIs, non-logging and non-training provider commitments, appropriate hosting for self-hosted models, open-weight loaders, file uploads, output evaluation and user notices. This establishes public policy content, not agency compliance or measured security outcomes. The displayed open-weight format/loader parameters remain placeholders, and no prior catalog version or changelog was found to identify the October update’s changes.
